name: help-text-contract-restated-across-surfaces
body: The `--module` contract is restated by hand in four surfaces — the help text, README, AGENTS.md and the `apg_scan` tool description — and the help text additionally enumerates the structural stream ids literally, while the help unit test checks neither the enumeration against `classify::is_structural_language` nor the four restatements against each other. A new structural stream id or a contract change can therefore drift out of one surface silently. Upgrade to a single-sourced or drift-checked documentation surface the next time the contract or the stream set changes.
